subject: Quick notary question
text:
Hi,

Hope your week stays mostly organized. I know we are only acquaintances, but as a colleague in the same building I wanted to ask one thing.

Do you remember mentioning a mobile notary service that came to your office last month? I have been trying to finish the vendor onboarding packet, and one signature page is still stuck in my drawer. I need to finish it before the quarterly review, but the in-person office near me closes early, and I cannot take another lunch break this week.

If you could share the company name, or even just the first name of the person you booked, that would help. I want to call about availability for this afternoon, perhaps around four or five. I am not sure whether they can visit after regular hours. I also need to ask if they charge extra for multiple pages or for a second signature block.

I do not want to rush you if you have to look it up. Whenever you have a moment, I would be grateful. If you think another service would be better, that note is welcome too.

Thanks,
